title: Authenticate display-client Bearer credentials

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Display Bearer authentication tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/serving_control/test_display_client_auth.py

evidence_required: display-client-access.md#authentication-contract RED: no display Bearer adapter exists; GREEN: exactly one Authorization Bearer candidate is hashed and matched to one active display_client, produces only id plus authoritative spa_id, rejects missing/malformed/unknown/reset/inactive credentials uniformly with 401, rejects body spa_id override, enforces deterministic positive per-token/IP limits with 429, and redacts token/header/digest from URLs and logs; decisive comparison: credential-state/override/rate-limit fixtures compare principal/status and scan captured logs; artifact: focused pytest and redacted scans under .tasks/TASK-057-T3-FT-003-W2/.
purpose: Implement the reusable realtime display-client authentication guard after credential persistence exists.
success_outcome: A current active display token authenticates to the correct immutable principal while every invalid state is uniform, rate-limited and non-leaking.
anti_goals: Do not mutate credential lifecycle or expose token_value.
Do not implement Admin settings, multipart validation or domain admission.
Do not introduce PKI, pairing, distributed limiter storage or a new auth framework.

forbidden_scope: Admin read/handoff owned by TASK-058 and TASK-059
stop_conditions: Correct auth requires a foreign writer or new framework.

constraints: Consume TASK-041 repository read boundary; never write credential state.
Use deterministic positive limits in tests and no limiter queue/distributed store.
Use disposable credentials and clean them without touching operator/default rows.
invariants: Principal spa_id comes only from the authenticated active row.
All invalid credential states are non-disclosing 401.
Token/header/digest never enter URL or logs.
verification_targets: Redacted URL/log scan and read-only owner review.
